title: History - Education Option
sourceText:
Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

HISTORY 101 [HUM]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

ECONS 102 [SSCI] or POL S 101 [SSCI]

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

HISTORY 102

HISTORY 121

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Arts [ARTS] (Non-History)
Only 3 HISTORY courses may be used to meet UCORE requirements.

ENGLISH 201 [WRTG], 301 [WRTG], 302 [M], or 402 [WRTG]
One from ENGLISH 201, 301, 302, or 402 is required for admission to the Teacher Education Program. Students who take ENGLISH 302 will need to take an additional [WRTG] or [COMM] course.

HISTORY 110

HISTORY 308 or 410

200-level HISTORY course
200-level HISTORY course: Choose one from HISTORY 224, 230, 232, 270, 271, 272, 273, 274, or 275.

HISTORY 111

HISTORY 120

HISTORY 279

Complete Writing Portfolio

300-400-level HISTORY courses
History education majors must choose their 12 hours of 300-400-level electives from the following: one from early U.S.: HISTORY 311, 313, 314, 316, or 415; one from Modern U.S.: HISTORY 312, 318, 319 or 417; one upper-division European History course; and one upper-division non-West History course.

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

HISTORY 300 [M]

TCH LRN 301

Foreign Language, if needed
Two years of high school foreign language or at least two semesters of college-level foreign language are required by the College of Arts and Sciences for graduation.

300-400-level HISTORY course
History education majors must choose their 12 hours of 300-400-level electives from the following: one from early U.S.: HISTORY 311, 313, 314, 316, or 415; one from Modern U.S.: HISTORY 312, 318, 319 or 417; one upper-division European History course; and one upper-division non-West History course.

HISTORY 324 or 380

HISTORY 469 [M]

TCH LRN 317 (Summer Session)

Diversity [DIVR] (Non-History)
Only 3 HISTORY courses may be used to meet UCORE requirements.

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

TCH LRN 464

TCH LRN 465

TCH LRN 466

ED PSYCH 468

TCH LRN 467 [M]

TCH LRN 469

TCH LRN 470

TCH LRN 415

Complete History Department’s Exit Survey

Students who wish to earn a teaching credential must apply to the Teacher Preparation Program in the College of Education, Sport, and Human Sciences. They should consult with an advisor in history about choosing additional electives that may apply toward a minor or second major and that complements a History endorsement.

To be admitted to the History - Education option, a student must make their intention known to the department and have earned at least a 2.5 cumulative GPA.

To graduate, a grade of C or better is required in all history courses used to fulfill the requirements for this degree.
